summary: Leslie County, KY lookout on Lucinda Knob: 1927 wooden tower (50 ft), later steel tower (about 98 ft in 1950). State radio tower and concrete foundations remain on site.

facts.design: Wood, 50 ft per a 1929 report; a 1950 survey describes steel, about 98 ft
facts.status_note: Fire tower removed; a state-owned radio tower stands at the site and the concrete foundations remain

events.note: Construction under way in June 1927; the completion date is not given
A February 1929 report describes one 50-foot wooden tower on Mt. Lucinda, Leslie county
A 1950 survey description gives a steel tower about 98 feet high, with four legs and an enclosed observation platform
Registered March 16, 2015 as US 1591, KY 2; nominated by Josephine Jackson

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Kept 15.2 m (50 ft) from the 1929 report. The 1950 survey (about 98 ft steel) and the page's removed 100-ft steel tower are reported as conflicting accounts, not merged.
The 1927 report places the work in Clay County's Red Bird section; the 1929 report and the Register say Leslie County. The record keeps Leslie County.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only, and the second is a transcript of old newspaper and NGS text on a fan site. No removal date for any tower. The 2006 spring description is a visitor's account about 20 years old. No access level is set because no source says whether the public can reach the site. The 1950 survey datasheet itself was not fetched; the transcript on the Forest Lookouts page was used. No photos added.
